note: Shared vectors for the decision-rule calculators on both platforms: web RULE_SPECS (artifacts/dashboard/src/lib/decision-rule-scores.ts, test decision-rule-vectors.test.ts) and iOS ClinicalScoringEngine+DecisionRules*.swift (DecisionRuleCalculatorTests.swift). `rule` is the web calculator key (decision-rules.json web.calculator), `ruleId` the decision-rules.json id, `values` the web form values (checkbox keys true, choice keys their option value), `total` the recorded value and `band` its decision-rules.json band. Published examples are marked in `name`. Change both platforms together.
